implementation: KCCE SHA-1, KCCE SHA-256, KCCE SHA-384, and KCCE SHA-512
description: KCCE is an independent, executable cryptographic module that exists variously as a dynamic linked library (dll), a shared library and a driver. KCCE provides software designers with a comprehensive API that ensures secure cryptographic application development, for a wide range of operating systems, without undue complexity.
